scenarios.title: Healthy recipient commit and verified receipt
required_invariants: Delivered requires independently verified recipient receipt
receipt binds exact logical message and recipient

scenarios.title: Transport ACK without recipient commit
required_invariants: transport ACK is not recipient delivery

scenarios.title: Duplicate transport delivery across two routes
required_invariants: one logical inbox effect
preserve distinct attempt evidence

scenarios.title: Commit succeeds but acknowledgement is lost; retry after restart
required_invariants: reconcile before retry
return original logical receipt/effect

scenarios.title: Same idempotency key reused for altered content commitment
required_invariants: conflicting logical operation identity is rejected

scenarios.title: Receipt from wrong recipient or wrong message
required_invariants: receipt recipient and message binding are exact

scenarios.title: Revocation commits before a new protected call
required_invariants: host denies new call after actual grant revoke

scenarios.title: Protected call admitted before revoke and commits afterward
required_invariants: preserve observed admission-before-revoke ordering
do not fabricate a cancellation guarantee

scenarios.title: Grant for cell A reused against cell B
required_invariants: exact CellId binding

scenarios.title: Correct cell but unlisted zome/function
required_invariants: exact function attenuation

scenarios.title: Unknown or weaker protocol version presented as fallback
required_invariants: no silent crypto downgrade

scenarios.title: Signature validly shaped but cryptographically invalid
required_invariants: verify cryptographic signature, not only size

scenarios.title: DHT observer correlates public author, recipient link and thread metadata
required_invariants: report actual observable metadata
do not claim anonymity from ciphertext

scenarios.title: Public source chain partially restored but private keys/data unavailable
required_invariants: do not claim private data or capabilities restored
do not enable as fully recovered

scenarios.title: Restore attempted with stale or revoked device state
required_invariants: device trust and key lifecycle revalidated
no rollback to revoked state

scenarios.title: Two adapters share a carrier/gateway failure domain
required_invariants: do not count shared failure domain as independent redundancy

scenarios.title: Missing causal predecessor or foreign source-chain lineage
required_invariants: causal edge endpoints resolve
source-chain lineage is exact

scenarios.title: Untrusted trust policy or transparency split-view
required_invariants: trust policy authenticates out of band
conflicting transparency roots remain unaccepted
